transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, thank you for seeing me. Um... I guess my mom really wanted me to come in, I hope that's okay to say. 

It's just... I've been having a little trouble getting things done lately. Well, honestly, I just can't seem to make myself do anything anymore. I used to really like knitting and journaling, and I'd go for walks all the time, but... now I mostly just sit in my room. I know it sounds bad, and I feel awful about it, but I just don't have the energy. I've kind of just been sitting there in the same clothes for a while, which I know is embarrassing to admit, I'm sorry. 

And when my mom checks on me and asks what's wrong, I... I barely even have the energy to answer her. Is that... does that make sense? I want to make sure I'm explaining things right for you.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once liked?

Oh, um, yes... I guess I kind of just rambled about that a second ago, I'm so sorry if I was getting ahead of your questions. But yes, it's exactly like you said. 

I just... I really can't make myself do anything anymore. I used to love my knitting and my journaling, and going for walks, but now I just... I sit in my room. And I know it's really awful that I stay in the same clothes, I'm really trying to be better about it, I promise. It's just... I don't have it in me. Even when my mom comes in to check on me and asks what's wrong, I barely have the energy to even open my mouth to answer her. 

Am I explaining that okay for you? I want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um, let me think... I want to make sure I give you the right timeline. I guess... well, it hasn't always been this bad, I promise. But I think this whole... decline, I guess you could call it, started around the time I began a community college program. 

That was about two years and two months ago, I think? I really hope I'm remembering that right. I just remember starting classes and then... things just slowly started getting harder. I feel terrible that it's been going on for so long and I haven't fixed it yet. Does that answer your question okay? I can try to think of a more exact date if you need me to.

Between the time you started feeling this way and any earlier periods, have you had any stretches where you felt back to your usual self—like you had more energy, enjoyed things again, and were able to take care of your daily responsibilities?

Um... no, not really. I'm sorry, I wish I could say yes. I know it would probably be better if I had, but... since it started, it's just kind of been like this the whole time. I haven't really had any periods where I felt like my old self again. 

I've tried, I really have, I don't want you to think I haven't been trying to get better. It's just... it's just been a steady sort of... low, I guess. I hope that's an okay answer. I'm sorry I don't have better news about that.
Have you ever experienced even a brief period—like a day or two—where you felt noticeably better, had a little more energy, or were able to engage in your usual activities, even if it didn’t last?

Um... I really wish I could say yes, because I know that's probably what you're hoping to hear. But... no, not even for a day or two. 

I'm so sorry, I feel like I'm just giving you all these negative answers and I really don't want to be difficult. I just... I haven't had any days where the energy came back, even a little bit. It's just been this same sort of... heavy feeling the whole time. 

I really am trying my best though, I promise. Is it... is it bad that I haven't had any good days? I hope I'm not messing up your evaluation by not having any breaks in it.
Would you say that most days, you feel down or depressed most of the day, even when nothing specific is happening?

Um, I guess... well, I don't want to sound like I'm complaining all the time. I know I should be more positive. But... yeah, I do feel kind of down most days. 

It's not like I'm crying all the time or anything! I try really hard not to let it show too much. It's just sort of this... quiet, flat feeling that sits there, even if it's a perfectly nice day outside. I hope that makes sense. I don't mean to sound ungrateful for the good things, I really don't. Is it okay that I feel that way? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right kind of information.
Would you say that your low mood or lack of energy happens on most days, and lasts for most of the day, even when there’s nothing specific bothering you?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I mean, I don't want to make it sound like I'm just sitting around doing nothing on purpose. I really try to push through it. But... most days, for most of the day, it's just... hard to find the energy. 

Even when nothing bad is happening, it's just... there. I'm sorry, I feel like I'm repeating myself and I don't want to waste your time. I know I should be able to snap out of it when things are fine. I'm really trying to be better about it, I promise. Is that... does that answer your question okay?
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, like waking up much earlier than usual and not being able to fall back asleep, even if you’re still tired?

Um... no, not really. I mean, my sleep is... it's okay, I think. I try to stay in bed and be quiet so I don't bother anyone, even if I'm awake. But I don't think I'm waking up super early like that. 

I really try to make sure I get enough rest so I can try to be more helpful during the day. I hope I'm not doing sleep wrong too... is it bad if I just sleep normally? I can try to pay closer attention to the exact times if you need me to, I just... I haven't noticed anything like waking up and not being able to go back to sleep. I'm sorry if that's not the answer you were looking for.
Have you noticed that you've been moving more slowly than usual, or that it's harder to get your body to respond when you want to do something?

Um, no, I don't think so. I mean, I try really hard to keep up with things and not slow anyone down. Sometimes I might take a little longer to get started, but I think that's just because I'm trying to make sure I do things right. 

I don't think my body is... like, not responding or anything. I really do try to move as quickly as I can when someone needs me to do something. I hope that's okay. I mean, I'm not moving too slow, am I? I can definitely try to be faster if I need to be. I just want to make sure I'm doing what I'm supposed to.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty, even when you haven’t done anything to cause those feelings?

Um... no, I don't think so. I mean, I definitely feel bad if I make a mistake or if I upset someone, because I really try hard to be good and not cause any problems for anyone. But... just feeling guilty when I haven't done anything wrong? I don't think I've noticed that. 

I try to be really careful to do what I'm supposed to do, so I don't have a reason to feel worthless, you know? I hope that makes sense. Is... is it okay that I don't feel that way? I mean, I know I'm not perfect, and I can definitely try to do better if I'm doing something wrong. I'm sorry, I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you ever felt so low or hopeless that you’ve thought about hurting yourself or that life wasn’t worth living?

Oh... um, no. No, I haven't. I promise I haven't thought about anything like that. I would never want to do something that bad or... or upset anyone. I know hurting yourself is wrong, and I try really hard to be safe and just do what I'm supposed to do. 

I mean, I know you have to ask, but I hope it's okay that my answer is no. I really don't want to be any trouble or make anyone worry about me like that. I just try to keep going so I can be helpful. Is... is that the right way to think about it? I'm sorry, I just want to make sure I'm doing okay for you.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in everything—like there’s nothing, not even things you used to really enjoy, that gives you any pleasure or motivation anymore?

Um... well... I guess I have been having a little bit of a hard time with that lately. I really hope it's not too bad, but... I don't know, mostly I just can't make myself do anything anymore. 

I try to be good, I really do, but I just end up sitting in my room. Sometimes I even stay in the same clothes, which I know isn't very nice, and I'm sorry about that. I just... I don't knit or journal or go walking like I used to. I want to, so I can be normal and not worry anyone, but when my mom asks what's wrong, I barely even have the energy to answer her. 

Is... is it okay that I'm like that right now? I'm not trying to be lazy or difficult, I promise. I just don't have the motivation right now. I hope you're not disappointed in me for that. I can try harder to do my knitting if that would be better?
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in everything—like there’s nothing, not even things you used to really enjoy, that gives you any pleasure or motivation anymore?

Oh... um, did I not explain it right just now? I'm so sorry. I wouldn't say I've *completely* lost interest in everything. I really hope I didn't make it sound like I've just given up, because I promise I haven't. 

I still... well, I still like it when my mom sits with me, even if I don't talk very much. I try to find little things to smile about so I don't make anyone sad or worried. So it's not nothing. I really am trying my best to stay interested in things so I can be normal again. Is... is it okay that I still have a little bit of interest? I just don't want you to think I'm not trying hard enough for you.
Have there ever been times when you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or extremely confident—like you didn’t need much sleep or that you could take on more than usual?

Oh, um... no. No, I don't think so. I don't think I've ever felt like that. I mean, I'm usually pretty tired, honestly. I definitely need my sleep. 

I don't think I've ever felt super energetic or... or confident like that. I really try not to be too loud or do anything that would bother people or take up too much space. I just try to stay quiet and out of the way. 

Is it bad if I haven't felt like that? I mean, I know it's good to have energy, and I'm sorry if I sound like I'm not doing enough. I just... I don't think I've ever had a time where I didn't need to sleep or felt unusually high. I hope that's an okay answer. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you noticed that it's harder to think clearly, concentrate, or make decisions, even about small things?

Um... I don't really think so? I mean, I hope I'm making sense right now. I try really hard to think things through before I say them or do them, so I don't make mistakes or cause any trouble. 

Sometimes I guess my thoughts get a little... jumbled? But I think that's just because I'm trying so hard to focus on being good and doing the right thing. I don't think it's anything too bad, really. I can still make choices, like what to wear or what to eat, even if it takes me a minute to decide. 

Is it okay if I'm a little slow sometimes? I promise I'm trying my best to concentrate when people talk to me, especially you. Am I answering your questions okay? I just want to make sure I'm doing this right for you.
